lead_raw_text:
The structure of TiFeO4 is orthorhombic with space group Pmn2₁ (No. 31) and a 12-atom unit cell containing Ti2Fe2O8, distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Fe centers with six O neighbors, Ti centers with four O neighbors, and two distinct O environments with four geometric neighbors each. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Fe 6-vertex and O 4-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Fe 6-vertex polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
